title: Testing toast notifications: assert via mocked useAppNotification, not DOM
answers: How do I test that a toast/notification was shown?
Why can't I find toast text with screen.getByText in tests?
How to assert success notifications in alerting import wizard tests
body: Toasts are dispatched through `useAppNotification()` (app/core/copy/appNotification) and rendered outside the component tree under test, so they never appear in the DOM from `render()`. Tests must `jest.mock('app/core/copy/appNotification')` and assert against the mocked `success`/`error`/`warning`/`info` functions (e.g. `expect(notifySuccess).toHaveBeenCalledWith(title, detail)`), not `screen.getByText`.
applies: Any component/test using useAppNotification for toast feedback, e.g. public/app/features/alerting/unified/components/import-to-gma/steps/Step1AlertmanagerResources.tsx
